cases.workflowStep: Sign in → navigate to /thinkspace/task
cases.uiLocation: TaskPage — header, work mode toggle, Today view menu
cases.title: Licensed user opens the Actions workspace
cases.what: A user with the thinkspace-task license opens the Actions module and sees the main workspace layout without errors.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in with automation credentials.
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/task.
3. Confirm the work mode group and Today/Week view menu are visible.
4. Confirm the page is not redirected to /403.
validationPoints: View menu shows Actions · Today or Week
cases.expected: Actions workspace loads with navigation controls visible.

cases.workflowStep: Today view → Week view → Today view
cases.title: Switch between Today and Week views
cases.what: The user switches calendar scope using the view menu and the URL reflects the selected view.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task (Today).
2. Open the view menu and choose Week.
3. Verify URL contains view=week.
4. Switch back to Today and verify week param is cleared.
validationPoints: Returning to Today restores default view
cases.expected: View toggles correctly between Today and Week.

cases.workflowStep: Open Actions → switch work mode to Agenda/Action
cases.title: Switch work mode to Agenda/Action
cases.what: The user changes work mode to Agenda/Action to see agenda-oriented columns and optional type filters.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task.
2. Click Agenda/Action in the work mode toggle.
3. Confirm the Agenda/Action mode button stays active.

cases.workflowStep: Prepare action → open /thinkspace/task/:id
cases.title: Deep link opens the correct action detail modal
cases.what: Opening a direct URL to a specific action loads the detail modal with the matching title.
cases.steps:
1. Create a test action (setup).
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/task/{id}.
3. Verify the detail modal opens and shows the action title.
validationPoints: Title text matches the created action
cases.expected: Detail modal opens for the linked action id.

cases.workflowStep: Guest session → open /thinkspace/task
cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot access Actions
cases.what: A user who is not signed in must be redirected to login when opening the Actions route.
cases.steps:
1. Clear session (no storage state).
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/task.
3. Verify redirect to /login.
validationPoints: User is not on Actions workspace

cases.workflowStep: Denied user → open /thinkspace/task
cases.title: User without thinkspace-task license sees forbidden page
cases.what: A signed-in user who lacks the thinkspace-task module license must not access the Actions workspace.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a user without thinkspace-task license (E2E_THINKSPACE_DENIED_USER).
2. Open /thinkspace/task.
3. Verify /403.

cases.workflowStep: Open bucketlist → type idea → Enter
cases.uiLocation: Bucketlist panel — input 'What's on your mind?'
cases.title: Add a bucketlist item with Enter key
cases.what: The user captures a quick idea in the bucketlist before converting it to a formal action.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task.
2. Open the bucketlist panel.
3. Type a title in the bucket input.
4. Press Enter.
5. Verify the item appears in the list.
validationPoints: Item row is visible with the typed title
cases.expected: New bucket item is listed in the panel.

cases.workflowStep: Actions page → FAB opens bucketlist
cases.title: Open bucketlist using the floating action button
cases.what: When the bucketlist side panel is closed, the user can reopen it from the FAB.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task.
2. Click 'Open bucketlist' if the panel is closed.
3. Verify bucketlist heading and input are visible.

cases.workflowStep: Bucket item → click Specific → quick-create modal
cases.uiLocation: Bucket row — Specific button → Quick-create modal
cases.title: Start Specific action from a bucket item
cases.what: Clicking Specific on a bucket row opens the quick-create modal with the bucket title prefilled.
cases.steps:
1. Add an item to the bucketlist.
2. Click Specific on that row.
3. Verify quick-create modal opens.
4. Verify title field contains the bucket text.
cases.expected: Quick-create opens in Specific mode with prefilled title.

cases.workflowStep: Bucket item → click Routine → quick-create modal
cases.uiLocation: Bucket row — Routine button → Quick-create modal
cases.title: Start Routine action from a bucket item
cases.what: Clicking Routine on a bucket row opens the quick-create modal configured for routine/recurring actions.
cases.steps:
1. Add an item to the bucketlist.
2. Click Routine on that row.
3. Verify quick-create modal opens.
4. Verify Routine action type is selected.
validationPoints: Routine radio or mode is active

cases.workflowStep: Bucket item → click ✕ remove
cases.title: Delete a bucketlist item
cases.what: The user removes an idea from the bucketlist without creating an action.
cases.steps:
1. Add a bucket item.
2. Click the ✕ button on that row.
3. Verify the item disappears from the list.
cases.expected: Bucket item is deleted from the panel.

cases.workflowStep: Bucket input → spaces only → Enter
cases.title: Empty or whitespace-only bucket title is rejected
cases.what: The application must not create bucket items when the user submits only whitespace.
cases.steps:
1. Open bucketlist.
2. Enter only spaces in the input.
3. Press Enter.
4. Verify no new row is added.
cases.expected: Nothing is added to the bucketlist.

cases.workflowStep: Bucket → Specific → fill form → + Create Action
cases.title: Create a Specific action from bucket quick-create
cases.what: The user converts a bucket idea into a saved Specific action with required fields completed.
cases.steps:
1. Add bucket item.
2. Click Specific.
3. Ensure title, start date, and assignee are set.
4. Click + Create Action.
5. Verify success toast and modal closes.

cases.workflowStep: Quick-create → enter description → save → verify in detail
cases.uiLocation: Quick-create modal — description field; Detail modal — description
cases.title: Create action with description notes
cases.what: Description text entered during creation is persisted and visible when opening the action detail.
cases.steps:
1. Create action with title and description via quick-create.
2. Open the action detail.
3. Verify description field contains saved text.

cases.workflowStep: Quick-create → clear title → attempt save
cases.uiLocation: Quick-create modal — title field; + Create Action button
cases.title: Cannot save quick-create without a title
cases.what: Form validation must block submission when the action title is empty.
cases.steps:
1. Open quick-create from bucket.
2. Clear the title field.
3. Verify + Create Action is disabled.

cases.workflowStep: Quick-create → Cancel
cases.title: Cancel closes quick-create without creating an action
cases.what: Cancelling the create flow must discard changes and close the modal without persisting a new action.
cases.steps:
1. Open quick-create from bucket.
2. Click Cancel.
3. Verify modal closes.
4. Verify success toast did not appear.

cases.workflowStep: Open action row from Today view
cases.title: Clicking an action row opens the detail modal
cases.what: From the Today view list, clicking an action opens its detail modal for read/update.
cases.steps:
1. Create a test action (setup).
2. Open /thinkspace/task.
3. Click the row containing the action title.
4. Verify detail modal opens.
cases.expected: Detail modal opens from list row click.

cases.workflowStep: Open detail → visit each tab
cases.uiLocation: Detail modal — Progress, Updates, Attachments, Hierarchy tabs
cases.title: All detail modal tabs are accessible
cases.what: The user can navigate all primary tabs in the action detail modal without errors.
cases.steps:
1. Open an action detail.
2. Click Progress, Updates, Attachments, and Hierarchy tabs in sequence.

cases.workflowStep: Detail → edit description → Save Description
cases.uiLocation: Detail modal — description textarea; Save Description button
cases.title: Edit and save action description
cases.what: The user updates the long-form description in the detail modal and saves the change.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Change description text.
3. Click Save Description.
4. Reload page and verify text persisted.

cases.workflowStep: Detail → Progress tab → set slider → Save
cases.uiLocation: Detail modal — Progress tab; range input; Save button
cases.title: Update action progress percentage
cases.what: The user sets progress on the Progress tab and saves; the UI reflects the new value.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Go to Progress tab.
3. Set slider to 50%.
4. Click Save if shown.
5. Verify slider value in UI.
cases.expected: Progress updates in the detail modal.

cases.workflowStep: Detail → type update → Post
cases.uiLocation: Detail modal — 'Post a progress update...' input; Post button
cases.title: Post a progress update comment
cases.what: The user posts a textual progress update that appears under the Updates section.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Type a comment in the update field.
3. Click Post.
4. Switch to Updates tab and verify comment text.
cases.expected: Update comment appears in Updates tab.

cases.workflowStep: Detail → empty update field
cases.title: Cannot post an empty progress update
cases.what: The Post button must stay disabled when the update comment field is empty.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Clear the update input.
3. Verify Post is disabled.
validationPoints: Post button disabled with empty input

cases.workflowStep: Detail → Progress → Done
cases.title: Mark action as Done
cases.what: The user marks an in-progress action as complete using the Done control.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Click Done on Progress tab.
3. Verify completion feedback (modal may close or status updates).

cases.workflowStep: Detail → Delete action
cases.title: Delete action from detail modal
cases.what: The user permanently removes an action using Delete in the detail modal.
cases.steps:
1. Open action detail.
2. Click Delete.
3. Verify modal closes and URL returns to list view.

cases.workflowStep: Create → open detail → edit description → progress → delete
cases.uiLocation: Full workflow across list, quick-create, and detail modal
cases.title: End-to-end lifecycle: create, update, and delete
cases.what: Validates the complete user journey from creating an action through editing and deleting it in the UI.
cases.steps:
1. Create action via quick-create.
2. Re-open from list.
3. Update description.
4. Set progress.
5. Delete from detail.
validationPoints: Each CRUD step succeeds in UI

cases.workflowStep: Open week view → verify navigation controls
cases.title: Week view shows week navigation controls
cases.what: In Week view the user sees controls to move to previous and next weeks.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task?view=week.
2. Locate Previous week and Next week buttons.

cases.workflowStep: Week view → previous week → next week
cases.title: Navigate previous and next week
cases.what: The user can browse adjacent weeks while remaining in Week view mode.
cases.steps:
1. Open week view.
2. Click Previous week.
3. Click Next week.
4. Verify still in week view (URL contains view=week).
cases.expected: Week navigation works without leaving week view.

cases.workflowStep: Agendas header click → Create New Agenda modal
cases.uiLocation: AgendasPage compact header — 'Click to create a new Agenda'; TaskPage modal
cases.title: Open Create Agenda modal from Agendas header
cases.what: Clicking the Agendas column header opens the Create New Agenda modal with workspace category Agenda, assignee options, and attachment zone.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/task in Agenda/Action mode.
2. Click the Agendas (N) header.
3. Verify '+ Create New Agenda' modal with Agenda workspace selected.
4. Verify attachment drop zone references Docflow/Attachment/agenda.
cases.expected: Create Agenda modal opens with correct fields.

cases.workflowStep: Agendas header → Create modal → Self (Me) assignee → + Create Agenda
cases.uiLocation: AgendasPage header; Create New Agenda modal — Agenda titles; Self (Me) radio
cases.title: Create agenda with Self (Me) assignee using test data TS-G01
cases.what: User opens Create Agenda from the Agendas column header, enters the dataset title (E2E Agenda — Weekly warehouse sync), keeps Self (Me) as assignee, and saves.
cases.steps:
1. Click Agendas (N) header (title: Click to create a new Agenda).
2. Verify '+ Create New Agenda' and 'Adding to: Agenda'.
3. Fill Workspace Category Agenda, title, Start Date & Time, and Self (Me) from TS-G01.
4. Click + Create Agenda.
5. Verify 'Agenda created.' toast and agenda card in Agendas column.
validationPoints: Agenda visible in Agendas column UI

cases.workflowStep: Create modal → External assignee → name + email → + Create Agenda
cases.uiLocation: Create New Agenda modal — External radio; name and email fields
cases.title: Create agenda with External assignee using test data TS-G02
cases.what: User creates an agenda assigned to an external guest by selecting External, filling name and email from TS-G02, and submitting.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Fill title and Start Date & Time from TS-G02.
3. Select External assignee.
4. Fill External Person's Name and Email from test data.
5. Click + Create Agenda.
6. Verify success toast and agenda card in Agendas column.
validationPoints: Agenda visible in Agendas column UI
cases.expected: Agenda created with external assignee resolved.

cases.workflowStep: Create modal → Employee assignee → directory search → + Create Agenda
cases.uiLocation: Create New Agenda modal — Employee radio; employee search dropdown
cases.title: Create agenda with Employee assignee using test data TS-G03
cases.what: User creates an agenda assigned to another employee by selecting Employee, searching the directory, picking a match, and submitting.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Fill title and Start Date & Time from TS-G03.
3. Select Employee assignee.
4. Open employee dropdown and search (hint: admin).
5. Select first matching employee.
6. Click + Create Agenda.
7. Verify success toast and agenda card in Agendas column.
validationPoints: Agenda visible in Agendas column UI

cases.workflowStep: Bulk titles (one per line) → + Create Agenda
cases.title: Create multiple agendas from bulk title lines
cases.what: User enters multiple agenda titles (one per line) and the system creates each agenda.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Enter two titles separated by newline.
3. Click + Create Agenda.
4. Verify both agendas exist via API.
cases.expected: Each non-empty line creates an agenda.

cases.workflowStep: Bucketlist Agendas tab → add item → Agenda → create
cases.uiLocation: Bucketlist — Agendas tab; Agenda button on row
cases.title: Create agenda from bucketlist Agendas tab
cases.what: User captures an idea in the Agendas bucket category and converts it to an agenda via the Agenda quick-create flow.
cases.steps:
1. Open bucketlist Agendas tab.
2. Add bucket item.
3. Click Agenda on the row.
4. Submit Create Agenda form.

cases.workflowStep: Create modal → empty title → submit blocked
cases.title: Cannot create agenda without a title
cases.what: Validation must block submission when the agenda titles field is empty.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Clear agenda titles.
3. Verify + Create Agenda is disabled.

cases.workflowStep: Create modal → Cancel
cases.title: Cancel closes Create Agenda without saving
cases.what: Cancelling the agenda create flow discards input and does not create an agenda.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Enter a title.
3. Click Cancel.
4. Verify no success toast.

cases.workflowStep: External assignee selected without name/email
cases.title: Cannot create agenda with External assignee missing details
cases.what: When External assignee is selected, name and email are required before submit.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create Agenda modal.
2. Enter a title.
3. Select External assignee.
4. Leave name and email empty.
5. Verify + Create Agenda is disabled.
validationPoints: Create disabled until external fields filled
